headline: Former Bengal minister Asish Banerjee found dead in West Bengal
summary: Former West Bengal deputy speaker and senior Trinamool Congress leader Asish Banerjee was found dead on Sunday inside a party office adjacent to his residence in Birbhum district. Local police recovered a suicide note at the scene citing personal reasons. Banerjee, a five-time MLA from Rampurhat, previously held key cabinet portfolios including agriculture and AYUSH.
why_it_matters: The sudden death of a veteran five-time MLA creates a political leadership void in Birbhum district and reshuffles internal Trinamool Congress dynamics.

summary: Ukrainian forces launched one of their largest coordinated drone attacks targeting six distinct Russian regions early Sunday morning. The operation marks a sharp escalation in long-range strikes targeting strategic supply lines deep inside Russian territory.

summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi announced a national initiative to advance artificial intelligence skilling, free online technical coaching, and indigenous defense technology. summary: A Comptroller and Auditor General audit revealed severe water safety violations across major Indian railway stations, detecting E. coli bacteria in public drinking outlets. The report cited inadequate filtration maintenance, unchecked storage tanks, and failure to meet mandated public health safety standards. Railway authorities pledged immediate corrective measures and comprehensive water quality testing across key passenger terminals.

summary: Bangladesh's men's cricket team scripted history on Sunday by defeating Australia in the first Test match at Darwin, securing their maiden Test win on Australian soil. Spinners spearheaded a dramatic second-innings collapse, bowling Australia out short of their target. The landmark result marks Bangladesh's most significant overseas Test triumph since obtaining Full Member status.

summary: Indian Railways successfully executed a 130 kmph speed trial of the country's first Vande Bharat freight EMU trainset on the Kota-Rohal Khurd corridor on Sunday. The 16-coach self-propelled cargo unit engineered by Integral Coach Factory features automated loading systems designed for rapid freight transfer, significantly reducing delivery times for time-sensitive commercial goods.

summary: The Reserve Bank of India issued new operational directives prohibiting digital lending apps from arbitrarily locking consumer smartphones during EMI payment defaults. The guidelines mandate clear consent frameworks, strict privacy protections against unauthorized remote data access, and standardized recovery procedures, curbing aggressive technology-driven recovery practices deployed by non-banking financial companies.

Emergency rescue teams deployed helicopters and specialized extraction units to treat survivors.
